subtitle.ar: أحاديث وتعريفات في العلم وحدوث العالم والنبوّة، من دروس العقائد النسفية
subtitle.en: Hadiths and classical definitions — knowledge, the origination of the world, prophethood — from the Nasafi creed lessons
subtitle.tr: İlim, âlemin hudûsu ve nübüvvet hakkında hadisler ve klasik tarifler — Nesefî akaid derslerinden

title.en: Prophethood and the Path of Deliverance

attribution.ar: نصوص عربية منقولة من دروس العقائد النسفية (الصحائف ١، ٢، ٤، ٦، ٧، ١٢)، مضبوطة ومقطَّعة للدراسة.
attribution.en: Arabic passages quoted in the Nasafi creed lesson notes supplied by the project owner (pages 1, 2, 4, 6, 7 and 12), transcribed from the rendered pages and segmented for study. The surrounding exposition in that source is in Ottoman Turkish; only its vocalized Arabic is used here. Three sentences — 2:s2, 2:s6 and 3:s2 — are the matn of al-'Aqa'id al-Nasafiyya itself, which the lesson notes render into Turkish rather than quoting; they are restored here in the received Arabic wording. 4:s3 is a hadith and 4:s4 is Al 'Imran 144; 4:s5 is Maktubat I:80, letter 69. All wording to be checked against critical editions before publication.
